title: Surjection in the formal coherent category is tested on the first infinitesimal layer
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian algebraic space X over S with quasi-coherent ideal I, a map of objects (F_n) -> (G_n) of the coherent formal category Coh(X, I) is surjective if and only if the degree-one map F_1 -> G_1 is surjective — the Nakayama-driven testability of epimorphism in the I-adic world. The retained proof is written: the abelian-structure comparison lemma (chapter lemma inverse-systems-abelian, already collected as a wave card establishing that Coh(X, I) is abelian and kernels/cokernels are computed levelwise etale-locally) makes surjectivity checkable on an affine etale cover of X; on the scheme side the statement is exactly the formal-functions lemma Cohomology of Schemes, lemma inverse-systems-surjective. Retained author proof at lines 9623-9628.
